runbook:
Inventory Docker disk usage and references. Clean only demonstrably unused images with bounded commands, then verify reclaimed space. Treat every volume deletion as destructive: explain candidates and require the command confirmation gate. Never remove running containers or use privileged containers. Skip unsupported platforms and state coverage gaps. Use readable commands; never evade a refusal. Finish with evidence, actions taken and recommendations.

Execution policy: investigate, apply the requested bounded fixes using run_command, then verify. Do not wait for plan approval. Only the command confirmation gate pauses execution. Never bypass a denied command.
